notes.title: Full Game Release | Big Final Update
New Update 29.02.2020
notes.notes:
[h2]The second major update to On The Verge II has been released![/h2]
[h3]This time it affected the Arcade: new content and other changes were added. 
The game has version 1.2.[/h3]

[h3]What has changed?[/h3]
• [b]Added a level system. Now the points received per round increase the player's level.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239090/971124cdfea25973338274cf57a26ce7fdda8539.png[/img]
   
• [b]New section in the profile dedicated to the Arcade. In this section, you can view information about the current level of the player and his record score.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239090/7b2b0bf374d6337479df19f249833b1d08037e41.png[/img]
         
• [b]Level limitations. Now some settings in the "Survival Mode" are available when a certain level is reached.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239090/8aa802c503ca16bdbbdcc0c4c7845579d299581a.png[/img]
        
• [b]New Arcade character – Michael Gromov. 
This character can be opened by reaching level 5 in the Arcade.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239090/a0abfca19ed43c9cc84d7349074170f199a873ff.png[/img]

• [b]Added animation for opening and closing the locker.[/b]

• [b]New Steam Achievements from Arcade[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239090/1eec61d078f628ec667e8278e52fbff0a16f198a.png[/img]
          
• [b]Special discussion for Arcade on Steam, the purpose of which is to share impressions or problems without leaving the game.[/b]

• [b]The test with the lever now has a consequence…[/b]

• [b]Bugs fixed.[/b]

notes.title: New Update 25.01.2020
notes.notes:
[h2]The first major update to On The Verge II has been released ! The game has version 1.1.
What has changed?[/h2]

[h3]I listened to the reviews and comments related to the initial Intro (Overture). You could say it was needlessly long and tedious.[/h3]
• [b]The initial screen saver has been completely redesigned: animated, shortened, and rewritten.[/b]

[h3]I fully agree with the players: the moment with the boxes, namely their number, was worth speeding up, at the same time some of the characters ' phrases were unnecessary.[/h3]
• [b]The number of boxes was reduced, and some phrases were cut out.[/b]

[h3]And other changes:[/h3]
[b]• Fixed bugs and bugs related to the gameplay, cut scenes, and the visual part;
• Fixed sounds that were not affected by sound settings;
• Fixed settings in the menu.[/b]

notes.title: On The Verge II Release Date
notes.notes:
Welcome to the 2020! This year, and at the same time the new decade, I want to start with the long-awaited news for many. 

The world release of On the Verge II will take place on January 3, 2020.
